[Act: rpwd
 Chapter: Registration of Institutions for Persons with Disabilities and Grants to Such Institutions
 Section: 54::Act not to apply to institutions established or maintained by Central or State Government.
]


Nothing contained in this Chapter shall apply to an institution for persons with disabilities established or maintained by the Central Government or a State Government.
